groups.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2
groups.description: OAuth2 login-button rendering on the Pivotable login page. The buttons themselves are produced by PivotableLoginWebnoneController.loginProviders(); the keys below gate which registrations surface.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.enabled
properties.description: Master toggle for OAuth2 login buttons. When false, PivotableLoginWebnoneController.loginProviders() short-circuits the registration scan and returns no OAuth2 entries (BASIC fakeuser remains visible if its profile is active). Default true via the Java fallback in the controller.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.github.enabled
properties.description: Per-provider gate for the github ClientRegistration. False suppresses the button while leaving the underlying Spring Security wiring intact.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.github.clientId
properties.description: Client ID for the github OAuth2 ClientRegistration. Consumed by spring.security.oauth2.client.registration.github.clientId via ${...} substitution in application-pivotable-demo_external_oauth2.yml.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.github.clientSecret
properties.description: Client secret for the github OAuth2 ClientRegistration. Pair with adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.github.clientId; provided via env var or system property for production.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.google.enabled
properties.description: Per-provider gate for the google ClientRegistration. False suppresses the button while leaving the underlying Spring Security wiring intact.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.google.clientId
properties.description: Client ID for the google OAuth2 ClientRegistration. Consumed by spring.security.oauth2.client.registration.google.client-id via ${...} substitution in application-pivotable-demo_external_oauth2.yml.

properties.name: adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.google.clientSecret
properties.description: Client secret for the google OAuth2 ClientRegistration. Pair with adhoc.pivotable.login.oauth2.google.clientId; provided via env var or system property for production.
